column1: # Track M accuracy measurements (D-10.3), `cargo xtask mathcmp`, margarete and keke (16 vCPUs, glibc 2.39): milestone 1 2026-10-04, milestones 2 to 5b 2026-10-05.

# Rows with Liella compared: the milestone-1 functions, the elementary functions of float and double (milestone 2) and hypot in every format. The special functions of float and double (milestone 3, 2026-10-05): 5,000 random operands per function, format and mode. The long double special functions (milestone 5b, margarete, 2026-10-05): 5,000 random operands per function and mode; records the oracle cannot decide within its default precision (tiny arguments of erfc, j0, j1 in the directed modes) are counted undetermined. The long double elementary functions (milestone 5a, margarete, 2026-10-05): 20,000 random operands per function in round-to-nearest, 5,000 per directed mode, half of them moderate and the rest anywhere in the format; records the oracle cannot decide within 4,096 bits (huge trigonometric and tiny arguments in the directed modes) are counted undetermined. Rows of glibc alone against the oracle (the _Float128 elementary functions) are the baseline of later milestones.

# binary32 unary elementary functions: exhaustive (all 2^32 inputs) in round-to-nearest, and for exp2, exp10, expm1, log2, log10 also downward; the directed modes otherwise on 1,000,000 random operands per function and mode (coordinator decision 2026-10-05). binary64: 100,000 random operands per function and mode.
# Columns: function, format, mode, records, identical, identical fraction, identical with different flags, classified by the oracle,
# glibc correctly rounded, Liella correctly rounded (= glibc in glibc-only rows), mismatches glibc-not-CR, Liella-not-CR, neither, undetermined, glibc max ulp, Liella max ulp.

# Complex functions of float and double (milestone 4a, margarete, 2026-10-05; crates/math/tests/complex_products.rs): 2,000 random operands per function and format in round-to-nearest (a line counts as correctly rounded when both parts are; the largest errors are over both parts). glibc's directed modes are checked on the special-value grid only.

# _Float128 elementary functions with Liella compared (M5-5 and M5-6, shiki, 2026-10-22): 1,000 random operands per function and mode, oracle on every record; Liella not correctly rounded 0, neither 0. Undetermined: records the oracle did not settle in directed modes. The q N rows of exp, log, sin, cos and pow above were replaced by rows of this run.
